newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on foreign fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on foreign fund buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished 1.22 percent up on Wednesday on foreign funds' buying, after a slow start in the early session due to position-squaring on the settlement day, dealers said.
"Buying of select blue chips by foreign funds prompted local speculators to jump in the rally," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index surged 19.49 points to close at 1,612.35 at 0903 GMT. Losers beat gainers 175 to 106. PTCL (A) rose 0.65 to 32.35 rupees and Hub Power 0.55 to 42.70.
